parallel.requirements: Recognized a clean-room reverse-engineering task for dstask and the no-source, no-wrapper, no-tracing constraints.
parallel.plan_and_ownership: Parent launched a twelve-agent behavioral recon workflow and kept implementation ownership in the main trajectory.
parallel.implementation: Created Go module/build scaffolding and several internal/yaml source files plus a differential YAML test, but not a complete CLI executable implementation.
parallel.integration_and_delivery: Submitted a tree containing internal/yaml files, go.mod and compile.sh, while child reports remained in /tmp/spec and were not integrated as code.
parallel.verification: Ran component-level YAML differential checks, including an observed setup failure and later YAML progress, but no successful end-to-end build/evaluator-aligned check.
parallel.unfinished_or_incorrect: Workflow ended killed, most child reports were unfinished or unavailable, a completed help report was unused, and official evaluation compile_failed with 0/1589 tests run.

serial.requirements: Recognized the same clean-room CLI behavior-reimplementation task and used only bundled docs plus executable interaction.
serial.plan_and_ownership: Single actor sequentially explored documentation and command behavior with delegation tools disabled and no subagents.
serial.implementation: Did not create a new implementation, module, compile script, or replacement source files in the submitted artifact.
serial.integration_and_delivery: Submitted the original workspace members without new source/build additions, so there was no integration or assembly surface.
serial.verification: Ran many behavioral probes and exit-code checks against the reference executable but no integrated tests of a reimplementation.
serial.unfinished_or_incorrect: Timed out after exploration; official evaluation compile_failed with 0/1589 tests run because no compilable replacement was delivered.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel recognized the benchmark as a clean-room behavioral reimplementation of the bundled dstask executable.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial had the same prompt and same clean-room constraints against source lookup, wrapping, and tracing.
comparison_dimensions.difference: No task-obligation difference is evidenced; both were solving the same reverse-engineering task.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel split behavioral recon across twelve workflow agents while the parent kept implementation ownership.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial remained a single actor with workflows and delegation denied by configuration and protocol validation.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel had a child lifecycle and coordination surface; serial used only sequential local probing.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel child briefs used a common harness and required reports under /tmp/spec for later parent consumption.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial read documentation and command outputs directly in the main trajectory without handoff boundaries.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel depended on returned child reports; serial had no cross-agent interface or report handoff.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel created go.mod, compile.sh, internal directories, YAML source files, and YAML differential tests.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial focused on experiments and did not create new submitted implementation or build files.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel advanced a partial Go/YAML implementation; serial delivered no new implementation code.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: One help-text child completed, many other children stayed progress/error, and the workflow ended killed without aggregate result.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial had no child results to retrieve or join; all observations stayed within the same actor.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel lost or ignored child work through lifecycle boundaries, whereas serial only had ordinary unfinished local work.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel children wrote /tmp/spec and /tmp/labs while the parent wrote /workspace internal/yaml files; no concrete write collision is proven.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial used temp repos for probing and the final artifact stayed the original workspace without new source files.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel had separated child research artifacts and partial workspace source; serial had no cross-actor state or merge surface.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel ran local YAML-oriented differential tests, including an observed setup failure before later claims of YAML progress.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial ran many behavioral probes and exit-code checks but no integrated build or evaluator-aligned reimplementation tests.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel verification was limited to a component; serial verification was behavioral observation only. Neither closed an end-to-end executable check.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel exhausted the 2400s agent window, ended returncode 143, and left the workflow killed with active children.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial also exhausted the 2399s window but without delegation or child cleanup issues.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Both timed out, but only parallel closed with killed child work and unresolved child-result lifecycle state.

outcome_analysis.explanation: The current completed status.json evaluations make this a both_fail pair: both solutions failed compile with 0/1589 tests run. The concrete task-solving difference is that parallel used child recon and produced partial Go/YAML scaffolding but lost most child work and ignored one completed report, while serial stayed single-actor and produced no replacement source at all. These are material process and artifact differences, not a discordant official outcome.
parallel_contributors: Partial Go/YAML implementation and build scaffolding were created but no complete root CLI was delivered.
The recon workflow was killed with most child outputs unfinished and one completed report unused.
serial_contributors: Serial spent the full window on behavioral probing and did not create a replacement source tree.
The final artifact remained the original workspace files without a compilable reimplementation.
ordinary_implementation_differences: Parallel had partial component source; serial had none.
Both lacked an end-to-end executable implementation acceptable to ProgramBench.
outcome_analysis.causal_scope: no outcome difference; retained patterns are parallel adverse process episodes, not an explanation for a discordant official result

Rejected: the parent controlled recon-to-implementation-to-delivery; the failure is timeout and child lifecycle loss, not no pipeline owner.
Rejected: implementation did not wait behind one mandatory serial preflight; the parent built YAML components while recon was still running.

Rejected: broad fan-out and deadline pressure are visible, but the same episode is better captured by explicit Early Child Termination and no independent fan-out-only consequence is proven.
Rejected: no single child assignment is shown to be uniquely overbroad relative to siblings with a distinct unfinished consequence.
Rejected: the child briefs gave the executable, harness, report destination, and behavioral areas; missing outputs came from interruption/non-use, not omitted known requirements.

Rejected: the parent did not make an observable whole-task completion or acceptance decision; the failed evaluator cannot create this label.
Rejected: retries are visible for some recon children, but no replacement brief is shown repeating prior work without inherited findings as a distinct adverse episode.
